mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which impairs atenolol elimination and increases risk of cardiac arrhythmias and hypotension in a beta-blocked patient.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust atenolol dosing based on renal function; supplement electrolytes as needed.
